title: PC2 authoritative prefix and usage product closure

law_conformance.note: The corpus executes the ratified prefix-identity and usage-accounting laws without provider I/O.

preserves: Prefix eligibility is derived from exact keyed identity and is not provider cache-hit evidence.
A verified hit needs supported routing, reusable prefix, and a positive provider-reported cache-read leaf.
Contribution order, adapter, protocol, policy, and key rotation are executed as exact keyed-receipt invalidations.
Missing, observed zero, positive, corrupt, billed, estimated, and unavailable remain distinct.
Every scorecard counter uses checked arithmetic under injected attempt and profile bounds, and every refusal leaves byte-identical state.
intentionally_excludes: Wall-clock benchmark timing; the remote performance receipt owns elapsed and peak-memory measurement.

determinism.identifiers: All identities are authored bounded fixture values.
determinism.network: No network access or provider call occurs.
determinism.filesystem: The test reads this bounded corpus without writing it.

record_contracts.actions: One bounded JSON object per line drives the real product scorecard and names its exact classification.

evidence.claim: Every corpus row is executed through the production scorecard; corrupt rows refuse without changing accumulated state.
